# Sabula 256

> Uganda's community prediction market — create your own market, invite friends, win real money via Mobile Money.

Sabula 256 (sabula256.com) is a parimutuel prediction market platform built for Uganda. Anyone can create a prediction market on any topic, share the link, and win money when the market settles. Payouts go via MTN or Airtel Mobile Money.

## What is Sabula 256?

Sabula 256 is NOT a sports betting site. It is a prediction market — a platform where users put real money on the outcome of future events, and winners split the pool. The platform takes an 8% rake on qualifying markets (pools of UGX 50,000 or more). There is no house edge in the traditional sense — the platform does not take the opposite side of any bet.

## How it works

1. **Create a market** — Any user can create a binary prediction market (Yes/No, Team A/Team B, etc.) on any topic by staking UGX 5,000 as a launch bet.
2. **Share the link** — The creator shares the market URL. Others join by placing bets on their preferred outcome.
3. **Settlement** — When the event resolves, admin settles the market by declaring the winning outcome. Winners split the entire prize pool proportionally to their stake.
4. **Payout** — Winnings are credited to the user's in-app wallet and can be withdrawn to MTN or Airtel Mobile Money instantly.

## Platform economics

- **Rake**: 8% of total pool, only on markets with pool >= UGX 50,000
- **Creator share**: 2% of total pool credited to market creator on qualifying markets
- **Minimum bet**: UGX 1,000
- **Maximum withdrawal**: UGX 1,000,000 per transaction
- **KYC required** for withdrawals above UGX 5,000,000

## Market categories

- **Football** — FUFA Premier League, Uganda Cranes, Premier League, Champions League
- **Politics** — Uganda elections, parliament, government policy
- **Economy** — UGX exchange rate, fuel prices, inflation
- **Entertainment** — Music, TV, film, celebrity
- **Tech** — Startup funding, product launches, crypto
- **Infrastructure** — Roads, power, construction
- **Agriculture** — Harvest prices, seasonal events
- **Other** — Anything else

## Technical details

- Built with Next.js 14, Supabase (Postgres), deployed on Vercel
- Payments via Relworx and MarzPay (MTN/Airtel Mobile Money aggregators)
- Real-time odds — live probability updates as bets come in
- PWA — installable as a mobile app
- Push notifications for market closings and settlement results
